plain: It moves across the sky: about 0.44 arcseconds per year, measured over 13 years (a confident measurement), which differs from the catalog value.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = 2.44 mag is very red, like T-type brown dwarfs.
Its brightness rises and falls regularly, every ~645 days (~142 or ~255 days fit the twice-yearly WISE visits equally well).
SPHEREx does not clearly detect it at 3.5-5 micrometres, so its spectrum cannot be typed.
